title: Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) Recommended Block Rules Unenforced
description: Microsoft's WDAC Recommended Block Rules list blocks known Living-off-the-Land Binaries (LOLBins) such as certutil, mshta, regsvr32, cscript, and wmic from being abused by non-elevated threat actors.
expected: WDAC Recommended Block Rules Policy Deployed and Enforced
impact: Attackers can abuse legitimate signed Windows binaries to bypass antivirus and execute remote staging commands.
remediation_guidance: Deploy Microsoft Recommended Driver and Application Block Rules via Windows Defender Application Control.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure Microsoft Recommended Block Rules is Enforced

title: PowerShell Constrained Language Mode (CLM) Disabled for Standard User Sessions
description: PowerShell Constrained Language Mode restricts language elements that can be used to invoke arbitrary Windows APIs, COM objects, or unapproved .NET types.
impact: Standard users and adversaries can execute custom C# scripts and invoke raw Win32 APIs directly from PowerShell.
remediation_guidance: Configure system-wide PowerShell Constrained Language Mode or pair AppLocker / WDAC with PowerShell lockdown.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure PowerShell Constrained Language Mode is Active
